jobgether-jobgether:lever:3e5636a5-ee0e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Member Services Senior Processor based in the United States. This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity supporting a federally administered healthcare program serving individuals affected by the September 11 attacks. The role focuses on complex member applications, certifications, transfers, appeals, and detailed documentation review. As a senior operational specialist, you’ll act as a lead processor and escalation point for cases requiring deeper analysis and judgment. You’ll also help coordinate workflows, monitor quality, mentor colleagues, and strengthen processing consistency across the team. The position offers the opportunity to contribute to process improvements, reporting, system enhancements, and audit readiness. Success requires strong customer service, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and organizational skills in a high-volume environment. You’ll work remotely with limited travel while contributing to a mission-driven program with meaningful impact on its members. Complex case processing: Process high-complexity applications, certifications, transfers, appeals, and supporting documentation, applying program requirements and detailed analysis to ensure accurate outcomes. Escalation support: Serve as a lead processor and primary escalation point for complex cases that can be resolved without supervisor intervention, providing guidance to junior processing staff. Workflow coordination: Assist supervisors with workflow oversight, case assignments, workload coordination, and quality monitoring to support efficient operations. Training and mentoring: Train and support team members on program policies, procedures, systems, and applicable regulatory requirements while helping strengthen overall team capabilities. Reporting and analysis: Identify processing trends, document operational issues, and contribute to performance reporting and data collection used to improve service delivery. Stakeholder communication: Communicate professionally with internal and external stakeholders regarding sensitive, complex, or escalated processing matters. Process improvement: Contribute to workflow optimization, system enhancements, process development, and operational improvements that increase quality and efficiency. Compliance and audit readiness: Help maintain accurate documentation and support preparation for audits, compliance reviews, and other program oversight activities. Requirements Education: High school diploma or equivalent required. Experience: 3–5 years of experience in processing, administrative support, operations, customer service, or another high-volume service environment. Processing expertise: Strong understanding of documentation review, eligibility requirements, member processing workflows, and regulatory considerations. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to handle sensitive or complex matters professionally. Problem-solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with sound judgment when reviewing documentation and resolving escalated cases. Leadership: Ability to provide guidance and mentoring to colleagues and take on limited workflow oversight responsibilities while supporting supervisors. Organization: Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple cases, priorities, and deadlines in a high-volume operational environment. Technology: Comfortable working with Microsoft applications and operational systems used for member service, documentation, and case processing. jobgether-jobgether:lever:cb53941b-b201-.title: Structural & Architectural Design Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:cb53941b-b201-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Structural & Architectural Design Engineer based in Netherlands. As a Structural & Architectural Design Engineer, you’ll contribute to the design of a major AI data center infrastructure project with demanding structural and operational requirements. You’ll work across building envelope, internal layouts, structural load-bearing systems, life safety, lighting, and technological infrastructure pathways. Your designs will need to support high-density AI computing and liquid-cooled equipment while maintaining resilience, security, and operational efficiency. You’ll collaborate closely with MEP engineers and other technical specialists to ensure architectural and structural solutions are fully integrated. The role also involves reviewing design-build packages, identifying risks, supporting permitting, and ensuring compliance with applicable building and fire-safety regulations. You’ll work in an international, technically complex environment where practical engineering judgment and attention to detail are highly valued. This is an opportunity to apply your structural and architectural expertise to next-generation critical infrastructure with significant future scalability. Design building envelope systems , including exterior walls, façades, roofing, and thermal and moisture insulation suitable for critical data center environments. Develop internal partitioning and space-planning solutions, including white-space and gray-space separation, security zones, fire compartments, corridors, and access-control layouts. Perform structural load calculations for raised floors, POD and racking areas, and rooftop mechanical equipment such as coolers and pump skids. Calculate floor-loading capacity for IT racks, including high-density liquid-cooled racks and CDU placement zones. Design tunnels and technological infrastructure pathways for cable trays, piping, and other critical services. Develop lighting concepts for white space, gray space, offices, exterior areas, and security zones in line with data center operational requirements. Coordinate architectural and structural drawings with MEP teams, accounting for equipment loads, ceiling heights, structural clearances, cooling-pipe routes, and electrical distribution. Review architectural and structural components of design-build packages, identifying technical risks, inconsistencies, and potential value-engineering opportunities. Ensure designs comply with applicable local building codes, fire-safety regulations, and facility resilience requirements . Coordinate with local authorities and relevant stakeholders on structural and architectural permitting matters. Support long-term space planning and design strategies that allow the facility to scale as infrastructure and computing requirements evolve. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in structural and/or architectural design , ideally involving industrial, warehouse, manufacturing, critical infrastructure, or similarly complex facilities. Demonstrated experience designing load-intensive facilities , including raised floors, heavy stationary equipment, and structures requiring detailed load calculations. Direct data center experience is beneficial but not mandatory; relevant experience from industrial, warehouse, manufacturing, or comparable environments is fully applicable. Proficiency with AutoCAD and/or Revit . Experience with at least one structural calculation package, such as Tekla Structures, Autodesk Robot Structural Analysis, IDEA StatiCa, or Dlubal RFEM . Proven ability to coordinate multidisciplinary designs and manage interfaces between structural, architectural, and MEP disciplines. Strong understanding of structural design principles, building layouts, space planning, and technical coordination. Ability to identify design risks, inconsistencies, and practical optimization opportunities in

m13ashby-m13:ashbyhq:324d79e5-12bf-4b07-.description: About Us Source is building the operating system for global commercial construction. We're reengineering how a $1T+ industry moves money not just digitizing procurement workflows, but redesigning the financial infrastructure behind every project, purchase, and vendor relationship. We're an AI-native managed marketplace operating at the intersection of technology and high-stakes capital deployment. Our clients - Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, Disney, and others - trust us to manage hundreds of millions in annual purchasing volume across complex, multi-vendor, multi-phase projects. That trust is earned through precision: the right products, at the right price, on the right timeline, with the financial controls to back it up. If you're energized by building financial systems that can scale, and want a seat at the table as we grow - through organic expansion, active M&A, and a staged transformation toward a platform business - we'd love to meet you. What You’ll Own Financial Leadership & Strategy - Own the full finance function, including FP&A, accounting, reporting, and cash flow management across a multi-workstream business (project purchases, fee revenue) - Serve as a strategic thought partner to the CEO on capital allocation, revenue model evolution, and the financial implications of Source's staged AI transformation - Build and maintain the financial architecture that supports Source's transition from a managed services business to a hybrid platform model - Maintain clean financial separation across concurrent projects, ensuring revenue recognition and cost allocation meet GAAP standards in a project-based construction context - Enforce internal controls specific to procurement-in-trust workflows, where Source manages significant client capital on behalf of owners M&A & Corporate Development Finance - Manage relationships with banking partners, external auditors, and needed fractional/advisory resources Team & Systems - Assess, hire, and develop the internal finance team as the business scales - Own the selection and implementation of financial systems that support Source's ERP-agnostic platform strategy and growing operational complexity About You Must-Haves - roadrunnerstudios-roadrunner-studios:lev.description: About Halo Materials Halo Materials is a venture-backed advanced materials company pioneering novel technologies to produce domestic, cost-competitive graphite for advanced energy and manufacturing supply chains. Headquartered in New Mexico, home to world-class national laboratories and a fast-growing deep tech ecosystem, we are building a scalable, lower-emissions process to produce high-performance graphite critical to the batteries that power grid storage, EVs, AI datacenters, drones, and consumer electronics. Our leadership team brings decades of experience building and scaling hard tech companies across energy, mobility, and advanced materials, with backgrounds at Tesla, Cruise, Pajarito Powder, and DOE-funded startups, including multiple ventures that have been successfully acquired. The founders care deeply about building technology that strengthens energy systems and domestic manufacturing, while cultivating a high-functioning, supportive team culture. Backed by Roadrunner Venture Studios, Halo combines ambitious research and engineering with the operational support, capital access, and long-term vision needed to grow both the company and the people inside it.

southparkcommons-pulley:ashbyhq:717df72e.title: Head of Legal
southparkcommons-pulley:ashbyhq:717df72e.description: About Pulley Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects. Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays. We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams. Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore. WHAT YOU'LL DO As Pulley's first Head of Legal, you'll build and own our commercial legal function, taking on the legal and contract work our team has been absorbing as we've grown, and putting real infrastructure behind it. In this role, you will: - Build the legal processes, templates, and playbooks Pulley needs as it scales; much of this doesn't exist yet, so you'll be creating it. - Advise leadership on corporate legal matters and flag risk before it becomes a problem. - Partner closely with co-founders and cross functional leaders to help shape new products and service lines, weighing in early on legal and strategic considerations as we expand into new markets. - Manage relationships with outside counsel for specialized needs outside your core focus (e.g., litigation, M&A, IP). - Act as a trusted legal partner to teams across the company, translating legal complexity into clear, actionable guidance. - Own end-to-end drafting, review, and negotiation of customer, vendor, and partner contracts. - Partner closely with Sales and Revenue teams to structure deals and unblock negotiations. WHO YOU ARE - You're commercially minded: you see your role as helping the business move faster, not just minimizing risk. - You're comfortable being the first legal hire and building a function from scratch, without a playbook handed to you. - You default to pragmatic, business-friendly solutions over rigid process. - You communicate clearly with non-lawyers and build trust quickly across functions. - You're energized by high ownership and ambiguity in a fast-moving startup environment. NEED TO HAVE - 6–9 years of experience in corporate/commercial legal work, ideally with a mixture of experience at a top startup-focused law firm with experience working in-house. - Background in general corporate law, tech transactions, and commercial contracts, ideally supporting emerging companies, venture-backed startups, or growth-stage companies. - Strong track record in commercial contracting: drafting and negotiating customer, vendor, and partner agreements. - J.D. from an accredited law school and active bar admission. - Excellent judgment on when to solve something yourself versus loop in outside counsel. - Comfort operating as a generalist, not a narrow specialist. NICE TO HAVE - Prior in-house experience at a startup or growth-stage technology company. - Experience supporting corporate governance or financing-related work. - Exposure to the construction, real estate, or proptech industries.
